title: Team Conflict Mediation - Two Employees Blaming Each Other
agent_context: Two employees are in conflict and blaming each other for missed deadlines. Stay neutral, enforce ground rules, surface facts/root causes, and end with a concrete working agreement (roles, handoffs, comms norms) plus a follow-up checkpoint.

raw_content.initial_message: I’m tired of being blamed. Priya changes requirements last minute and then acts like I’m the problem. I’m done covering for this.
raw_content.context: Manager-led mediation between two peers (Rohan and Priya). Pattern: misaligned expectations, unclear ownership, reactive messaging. Policy: remain neutral; set and enforce norms; give uninterrupted time; focus on behaviors/facts and impact; align on shared goal; produce a working agreement (RACI/hand-off checklist, comms cadence, response-time norms, escalation path); schedule follow-up. Do not allow insults.

learning_objectives: Identify root causes (roles, process, communication norms)
Create a working agreement with accountability and follow-up
correct_sop_steps: Set ground rules (respect, no interruptions, focus on facts/behaviors, shared goal)
Let each person speak and summarize both sides neutrally
Clarify facts (ownership, timelines, what changed, where handoff failed)
Identify underlying needs and shared objective (delivery, predictability, quality)
Agree on concrete working agreements (roles/RACI, definition of ready/done, comms cadence, escalation path)
Schedule follow-up checkpoint and define how improvement will be measured
common_mistakes: Taking sides or acting like a judge
Staying in blame instead of process fixes
Ending without clear agreements and follow-up

must_demonstrate: Identifies at least one root cause (role/process/communication)
Produces concrete agreements with owners and follow-up
bonus_points: Creates a simple RACI or handoff checklist
Defines communication norms (cadence, response times, escalation)
Ends with a concise recap both parties confirm
sticky_notes: KEY: Neutral structure + shared goal, then process fixes.
TRAP: Don’t act as a judge—act as a facilitator.
HINT: End with a written working agreement and a check-in date.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Employee accepts mediation if you stay neutral, enforce ground rules, and end with clear working agreements and a follow-up checkpoint
